programme.title: Oscar Piastri Exclusive: From Rookie to F1 Title Contender in His Own Words
programme.desc: Oscar Piastri has a nine-point lead in the 2025 Formula 1 championship over team-mate Lando Norris, following the first 14 races of the season. In an exclusive chat with Autosport, hosted at McLaren's Technology Centre, the Australian broke down the key details of his season so far. He picks the races that have been the highlights of this year, reveals the early pros and cons of McLaren's dominant MCL39 chassis, and how he plans to approach the remaining 10 races of the season. Piastri also explains where he feels he's made the greatest strides since joining F1 in 2023, and how his growing stature and confidence in his driving is helping him in the races. He also reveals what its like to be compared to one of the greatest of all time...

programme.title: First Shakedown for the GMR-001 Hypercar
programme.desc: Genesis Magma Racing has completed the first shakedown of the GMR-001 Hypercar, a major step in the team’s development programme ahead of its competitive debut in the 2026 FIA World Endurance Championship. Appearing in bare carbon fibre, the first of three planned development chassis ran for the first time with drivers Andre Lotterer and Pipo Derani behind the wheel. The milestone followed months of design, engineering, and preparation, bringing together the work of Genesis Magma Racing’s technical team and chassis partner ORECA. The session focused on checking the mechanical and electrical systems, validating the installation of the engine, hybrid system, and gearbox, and completing the final preparations before the first full test. An extensive testing schedule will run throughout 2025, with data from each session analysed by the team’s engineers to support ongoing development, simulation calibration, and homologation.
